name: lag_n_missing
description: How many of the three lags were missing and had to be filled
formula: count of NaN in lag_336h / lag_504h / lag_672h before filling
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: lag_336h
description: Trips in the same zone 14 days earlier (spikes capped; holes filled)
formula: shift(336 h); if missing: mean of the other lags, else train zone x hour-of-week mean
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: lag_504h
description: Trips in the same zone 21 days earlier (holes filled)
formula: shift(504 h); if missing: mean of the other lags, else train zone x hour-of-week mean
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: lag_672h
description: Trips in the same zone 28 days earlier (holes filled)
formula: shift(672 h); if missing: mean of the other lags, else train zone x hour-of-week mean
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: same_how_mean
description: Mean of the three same-hour-of-week lags
formula: nanmean(lag_336h, lag_504h, lag_672h); if all missing: train zone x hour-of-week mean
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: level_28d
description: Zone's mean trips over the 28 days ending 14 days earlier (trend level)
formula: shift(336).rolling(672); if missing (start of year / new zone): train zone mean
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: level_7d
description: Zone's mean trips over the 7 days ending 14 days earlier
formula: shift(336).rolling(168); if missing: train zone mean
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe

name: level_ratio_7_28
description: Short vs long level (momentum)
formula: level_7d / level_28d; 1.0 when either level was missing
why_expected_to_help: recent demand level is the best single predictor; lags >=14 days keep it forecast-safe
